articles.chapeau: Rockstar’s Leonida looks like it was built by car people, and GTA 6 has one surprise for gearheads the series has never pulled off before.
articles.txt:
By Hari Krishnan Published Nov 8, 2026, 11:01 PM EST Hari is an automotive journalist and MA Automotive Journalism student at Coventry University, whose passion for cars began long before it became a profession. Born and raised in Kerala, India, he spent years immersed in car culture before channelling that obsession into a career built on storytelling, research, and genuine enthusiasm for machines that move people.
He cut his teeth in automotive media at Flywheel — the platform founded by Hani Musthafa, the most prominent automotive journalist from South India and the only journalist from the region to serve on the World Car of the Year jury panel. Over two years, Hari produced and managed over 1,000 pieces of digital content across Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms, covered OEM press events for brands including Mercedes-Benz, Kia, Tata Motors, and MG Motor India, and built the visual and editorial framework that brought the platform back to life from scratch.
Alongside his studies, Hari runs Living Metals Media, an independent automotive blog covering everything from exotic hypercars to motorsport history, where his voice as a writer has been sharpened one article at a time.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is packed with stuff to keep players busy, but car nuts? We might've just hit the jackpot. Leonida looks like it's got every flavor of driving on the menu. Want to rip a supercar along Miami-inspired streets? Vice City's got you. Rather bury a truck up to its axles in mud? Yep, there's a spot for that, too. The game drops November 19, 2026, and between Rockstar's trailers and screenshots, we've had a good long poke around Leonida. The verdict? Gearhead heaven.
Vice City Rockstar Games Most players will probably live in Vice City, and car fans won't complain . Rockstar's take on Miami goes from flashy beachfront strips to grittier hoods where built cars and street culture are just part of the scenery. Ocean Beach is where you roll up in a supercar and let everybody stare. Stockyard? Whole different vibe. The street art and industrial feel are pure Wynwood, Miami's mural-covered arts district, and the kind of spot where a slammed build looks right at home.
Ambrosia Rockstar Games Look, not everyone wants to baby a Lamborghini. Some of us would rather grab a ridiculous off-road build, point it at the nastiest trail around and see how long it lasts before something lets go. Enter Ambrosia. The region looks like home turf for the Thrillbilly Mud Club, a bunch who clearly couldn't care less about clean trucks. Over on Lake Leonida sits One-Eyed Willie's, an off-road mod shop for Ultimate Edition owners who love wrenching on their rigs. The Ultimate Edition also throws in the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy. That's basically GTA's take on a first-gen Mustang, jacked sky-high and turned loose in the mud. Yes, really. Rockstar calls it a "Mud Club monster," and honestly, no notes.
Grassrivers Rockstar Games Okay, this is the part that had us doing a double take. Rockstar's Extended Look showed an actual wheel-to-wheel circuit race, lap counter, timer and all. GTA has done ovals, dirt tracks and street races before, but a proper road course? Never. Fans figure it sits near Port Gellhorn and borrows loosely from Sebring, home of the famous 12-hour race, though Rockstar hasn't confirmed either.
Then there's the Leonida Keys, which look lifted from Florida's Overseas Highway. The real deal runs 113 miles and hops across 42 bridges with nothing but water on both sides. Rockstar's version is made for a lazy sports car cruise, as long as you can keep your right foot in check. Spoiler: you can't.
Still hungry? You can rip through the Grassrivers swamps on an airboat and send it through the Mount Kalaga backcountry on dirt bikes City streets, muddy trails, coastal highways and a real racetrack. Missions? Sure, eventually. GTA 6 looks like it'll keep car fans way too busy driving to care.

articles.t: Leaked GTA 6 release date build hints online multiplayer could launch soon
articles.chapeau: Some rumors point to a GTA 6 online mode not launching until later in 2027. However, a data miner leaked code from the release date build alluding to multiplayer features. The profitability of GTA Online raised doubts that Rockstar would be eager to transition players.
articles.txt:
With pre-loads set to begin, data miners are discovering clues about Rockstar ’s anticipated title. PlayStation Game Size found traces of online functionality in the GTA 6 release date build. While a multiplayer mode will not launch on November 19th, it could arrive sooner than anticipated.
An investigation of the PlayStation backend revealed references including “joinSession”, “launchActivity”, and “launchMultiplayerActivity.” These leaked strings indicate gamers can create or join sessions and initiate multiplayer-focused events.
Despite the curious GTA 6 release date code, a sequel to GTA Online could still be many months away. Developers may have prepared to add a multiplayer component seamlessly in the future. Regardless, an extended delay conflicts with a pattern set by GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 .
With the previous Grand Theft Auto , an online mode emerged two weeks after the solo campaign debuted. Meanwhile, Red Dead Redemption 2 saw a beta option surface about a month following the open-world western's release.
On the other hand, GTA Online remains lucrative for Rockstar, and it may hesitate to leave supporters behind. Bloomberg insider Jason Schreier downplayed the chances of the studio announcing a sequel to service in the near future. He later said fans may need to wait until 2027 for co-op missions.
In an interview, Twitch CEO Dan Clancy discussed how the streaming platform would benefit from the game. Still, he explained that an expected GTA 6 Online in 2027 would produce a bigger surge in viewership. Since Rockstar acquired Cfx.re, there is hope for a popular role-playing mode similar to GTA 5 .
The latest leak reminds observers of messages exposed during a Rockstar employee tribunal. Discord logs mentioned a 32-participant multiplayer test session in October 2025. Even if the saga of Jason and Lucia takes priority, an alternative to single-player is planned.
Data miners are on high alert as the November 10th GTA 6 pre-loads commence first in New Zealand at midnight local time. As files become accessible on Xbox and PS5 consoles , more findings seem inevitable.

Sofia Lindström November 9, 2026 12 min read A Leeds studio most gamers rarely think about may matter more to Yorkshire than the region’s best-known indie hits. The Yorkshire Post reported that Rockstar Leeds, the northern England base of Rockstar Games, could help the area’s wider gaming sector as Grand Theft Auto VI draws attention to the company’s footprint. The paper spoke with Jamie Sefton, managing director of Games Republic, who described a studio whose influence runs well beyond its own payroll.
The timing is hard to miss. GTA 6 coverage has dominated gaming news for weeks, from the market jolt Take-Two took from leaks to a steady drip of official promotion. Most of that coverage centers on New York, where Rockstar Games is based, and on the faces at the top of the company. The Leeds angle shifts the lens to the people who build the games and the local ecosystem that grows around them.
This analysis separates what the reporting actually establishes from what remains expectation. That distinction matters here. The Yorkshire Post piece confirms Leeds involvement in the project, but it does not say Rockstar Leeds alone makes the game, and it does not confirm hiring numbers, a budget, a release date or any technical detail for Grand Theft Auto VI. We stay inside those limits throughout, and we flag where the story turns from fact to forecast.

The core of the story is simple. Rockstar Leeds is part of the development of Grand Theft Auto VI, and Yorkshire’s games industry stands to gain from that connection. The reporting rests largely on Sefton, who runs Games Republic and speaks for a regional industry that has lived alongside the studio for more than two decades.
Sefton framed Rockstar ‘s Leeds presence as long-term and structural. In his telling, the studio is not a recent arrival chasing a hot franchise. It is part of the region’s industrial identity, and its alumni have gone on to build companies of their own. A second voice in the piece, identified only as Ms Fadel, said she looks forward to seeing Rockstar developers at industry events again, a small detail that hints at how much of the studio’s community involvement has been quiet in recent years.
The Yorkshire Post also relays an expectation from industry experts that Rockstar’s presence could bring “swathes of new jobs” and fresh businesses to the area. We treat that as exactly what it is, an expectation. No recorded outcome backs it yet, and the reporting does not attach numbers to it. Readers should hold that line too when the story gets repeated on social media with firmer wording than the source supports.

Rockstar Leeds took shape in 2004, when Rockstar Games acquired the company then known as Mobius Entertainment and rebranded it. In its early days the studio worked out of a converted 18th-century church, an unusual home for a team building crime games. articles.txt:
A datamine says GTA 6 launches with 55 achievements, four more than GTA 5 had on day one, plus a likely Platinum trophy. Here is what is confirmed so far.
GTA 6 achievements may total 55 at launch, according to a datamine shared on X on November 7, 2026. Rockstar Games has not confirmed the figure, but if it holds, GTA 6 will launch on November 19 with a slightly longer list than GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2 had on day one.
Achievements on Xbox and trophies on PlayStation are profile rewards for finishing specific in game goals. The leak comes from dataminer TexFunz2 via the fan site iGrandTheftAuto.com, which says 54 entries carry point values from 1 to 54 while one is set to 1,000. That last entry could be a reward for completing the full set or a placeholder for an Xbox Mythic achievement, the newer top tier Microsoft gives players who finish a game completely.
GTA 6 currently has 55 achievements configured. Interestingly, 54 use values between 1 and 54, while another is assigned 1000. That 1000-point achievement could be for completing the entire set, or it may be a placeholder for an Xbox Mythic achievement. via @TexFunz2
The reported number is 55, split into 54 regular entries and one top reward. Insider Gaming reported the same total on November 8 and compared it with earlier Rockstar releases. Other outlets say a PlayStation dataminer found 55 trophies on the PS5 side too. No names, descriptions or unlock requirements have leaked, and the point values look like placeholders.
GTA 5 later grew to 78 achievements as Rockstar added GTA Online content over the years. GTA Online for GTA 6 is not expected at launch, so any online rewards will likely arrive later as a separate list.
Probably. A Platinum trophy on PS5 unlocks once you earn every other trophy, and the 1,000 point entry points to a matching top reward on Xbox. Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft have not commented, so treat this as likely rather than certain. While you wait, our GTA 6 preload guide covers the November 10 start and the 212GB download.
Not much about the size of the game. Rockstar has promised its densest world yet, and the 39 new GTA 6 screenshots show how much ground Leonida covers. A list only four entries longer than GTA 5's suggests Rockstar is keeping the launch set focused rather than padding it with hundreds of collectibles.
Completionists should not plan routes around a leaked number. Wait for the official list, which often appears on PlayStation and Xbox shortly before release, and be careful where you look: as our GTA 6 spoilers guide explains, achievement names are often one of the first ways story twists leak.

Five things to know about 'Grand Theft Auto' AFP Mon, 9 November 2026 at 2:46 am CET 3 min read The next title in the GTA series is widely expected to be the biggest game of the decade (SAEED KHAN) The video game that launched 1,000 controversies and made billions of dollars for its studio is back -- "Grand Theft Auto VI" will hit a console near you on November 19.
The title is widely expected to become the biggest game of the decade, its launch coming 13 years after the previous edition scaled new heights in terms of gameplay and profitability.
The first two games in the series, which debuted in 1997, offered a top-down view of the action as players took on the role of a criminal on missions around cities.
But "GTA III" set the standard in 2001 for what games could be like, offering a combination of a three-dimensional open world, advanced graphics and gameplay that won widespread critical acclaim and legions of fans.
Each new GTA title since then has been hailed by both industry analysts and gamers for pushing the boundaries of what is possible in the medium.
And they have all been bestsellers, bringing in billions of dollars for Take-Two Interactive, parent company of the Rockstar Games studio.
Despite not releasing a flagship GTA game for more than a decade, the series has remained a cash cow, especially thanks to its multiplayer online version, where users can buy in-game items.
The last game in the franchise, "GTA V", was released in 2013 and reached $1 billion in retail sales "faster than any entertainment release in history", Take-Two has said.
"GTA V" has sold around 230 million copies, according to the company's most recent figures, making it the second best-selling game of all time, behind Minecraft.
The entire GTA franchise has sold a mammoth 470 million units, according to Take-Two.
With the wild success came a wave of controversies. Critics have from the start accused the series of glorifying violence and encouraging players to engage in criminal behaviour -- allegations Take-Two executives have denied.
GTA games have also faced strong criticism for misogynistic portrayals of women, caricatures of ethnic minorities and depictions of torture.
Despite being praised for their often biting cultural satire, the level of violence in the games has at times led to bans and restrictions in some countries.
Target Australia stopped selling "GTA V" in 2014, citing customer concerns. GTA games also carry a content rating for mature audiences only. Take-Two executives have said customers should be free to choose what games they buy.
GTA has become a cultural institution despite the criticism, with its content spawning countless online memes and fans around the world referencing its scenes and dialogue.
Its growing influence has attracted some of the biggest names in entertainment to its cast. Tommy Vercetti, the main character in 2002's "GTA: Vice City", was voiced by Hollywood star Ray Liotta.
Other cameos in the series include Samuel L. Jackson, Burt Reynolds, musician Phil Collins and comedian Ricky Gervais. In 2021, hip-hop superstar Dr. Dre featured.
The French electro duo Justice is composing the soundtrack for "GTA VI" and an album built around the game's universe brings together musicians including rapper Travis Scott and Rolling Stones guitarist Keith Richards.
The studio formally revealed "GTA VI" with a trailer in December 2023.
The new game is set in Leonida, a fictionalised version of Florida that includes a return to the Miami-inspired Vice City. It follows a criminal couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
Originally targeted for late 2025, "GTA VI" was pushed back twice before settling on its November 19 release date on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
The game reportedly cost between $1 billion and $1.5 billion to produce, which would make it the most expensive cultural product ever.

GTA 6 lands in under two weeks, and the hype machine is jumping time zones from Miami to London. Some of it is the kind of Vice City gear fans have wanted since the first trailer. Some of it is priced like Selfridges expects you to pay with heist money. Selfridges announced the event on Instagram, telling followers to “experience the world of Grand Theft Auto VI” at the store starting November 9 . Its Christmas windows already feature a Vice City scene, complete with a Burger Shot cup. Further down the list you’ll find £20 Manatees socks, £25 dad caps, a £35 magnet set, and a £55 enamel pin set.
If you’re a GTA fan, a lot of this is cool. The Manatees helmet and the varsity jacket are exactly the kind of in-universe pieces collectors put on a shelf next to their PS5. Not everything here is new, though. Several tees, including the GTA VI Logo, Rockstar Games Logo, and Goodtime State designs, look identical to shirts already sold on the Rockstar Store for $29.99. Selfridges is listing them at £50 to £55, which works out to roughly $67 to $74.
One more wrinkle: a September datamine of Rockstar’s own store catalog tagged several of these designs as UK items, including the Narcos tee, the Burger Shot ringer tee, and the Manatees snapback. That hints at UK exclusivity, but it also means some pieces could surface on Rockstar’s store later.
The biggest unknown is distribution. Selfridges hasn’t said whether the collection will sell online, and if it does, whether it ships internationally. That matters a lot. America has no shortage of GTA fans, and anything locked to a London pop-up could carry a serious premium with US buyers.
For UK resellers , the pop-up is the play. Focus on the pieces that look limited, like the helmet, the hoop, and the outerwear, and skip the tees, mug, and keychains that overlap with Rockstar’s own store. Run the numbers first. After eBay’s 13.6% fee, the £450 helmet (about $603) needs to sell for roughly $700 just to break even, before you pay to ship a bulky box overseas. The varsity jacket needs nearly $3,900. Nobody knows yet whether US buyers will pay that. Return and refund terms for the collection haven’t been published, so confirm them in store before you commit real money.
For US resellers , there’s nothing to do but wait. Selfridges’ London stores open at 10 AM UK time, which is 5 AM ET and 2 AM PT, and the online store could go live at the same time. We probably won’t know for sure until then.
This looks like one of the last major merch drops before GTA 6 launches on November 19, and resellers are still hunting for ways to cash in on the hype. The Selfridges collection has some of the coolest GTA gear we’ve seen so far, but the prices deserve a double-take. Don’t rush into anything until Selfridges confirms how it’s selling the collection. We’ll update this article as soon as we know more.

articles.t: GTA 5's DJ Cara Actor Has Booked Two Weeks Off to Play GTA 6 | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Cara Delevingne and Lewis Hamilton say they are clearing time for GTA 6, while Bulkhead is giving its whole team December off.
articles.txt:
Cara Delevingne says she has booked two weeks off to play Grand Theft Auto VI when it arrives on November 19.
The British model and actress, who happens to voice DJ Cara on the pop station in Grand Theft Auto V , says she has booked two full weeks off once the game is out. She is not being shy about why.
"I love that game, I always will," Delevingne said in a red-carpet interview, adding that she still wears her old Grand Theft Auto merch and "booked out two weeks after the game comes out" because "it's gonna be incredible." She is a vocal fan and Rockstar Games once hired her to play a version of herself on the radio.
The role is a real one. Delevingne voices DJ Cara, the hyper, sarcastic British host of Non-Stop-Pop FM at 100.7 in Los Santos, a part she recorded around the 2013 release and returned to for the enhanced versions . It was one of her first proper acting credits, back when she was better known for runways than radio. The clip of her two-weeks-off comment has been passed around.
There is a nice symmetry to it. DJ Cara has reportedly recorded fresh farewell lines for Grand Theft Auto Online , sending players off toward Vice City and teasing a final in-game meetup around November 18. So the same voice telling Los Santos goodbye on the airwaves is the one clearing her schedule to move on. Fans have already turned that farewell into a mass cruise through Los Santos the night before launch , a send-off hosted, fittingly, in DJ Cara's voice.
Previously, when Delevingne was asked if she'd return for the sequel, she gave a laughing "no comment."
Regardless of a potential return, she is in good company. Booking time off for a video game used to be a punchline. Now it's become a trend all over the world . F1 champion Lewis Hamilton says he will cancel work to play it and clear his whole schedule around launch. A games studio, Bulkhead, is giving its entire team December off and telling players to go enjoy it.
It's not a famous-exclusive phenomenon either. HR data shows a GTA 6 time-off surge that GTA 5 never caused .
GTA 6 has famous fans and regular workers alike booking time off, with Cara Delevingne literally in the game.
GTA 6 has famous fans and regular workers alike booking time off, with Cara Delevingne already voicing DJ Cara in GTA 5 .
Delevingne also sits in a longer Rockstar tradition. The studio has a habit of casting real celebrities as radio hosts, from Karl Lagerfeld on Grand Theft Auto IV 's electro station to a string of real DJs across Grand Theft Auto V . Delevingne was the rising-model-turned-host in that group. The rumor is that, another DJ in DJ Khaled, among others , will play a similar role in GTA 6 .
With that said, Delevingne has spent eleven years telling Los Santos what song is coming next. Now she is counting down to Vice City with everyone else, except she gets to hear her own voice say goodbye on the way out.

If your console has been off for a while, turn it on and check for updates before the preload goes live. PS5 owners have it easier, since system updates can download and install on their own in Rest Mode as long as the console stays connected to the internet.
The game is roughly 212 GB, so download time depends on your internet speed.
Buying a boxed copy does not give you a disc. The box contains a code that unlocks the digital version of the game.

articles.txt:
Headlines this week say Grand Theft Auto VI could be pirated on PlayStation at launch and that Rockstar’s owner isn’t worried. The on-record material is narrower. LevelUp, The Times and Mashable India all ran versions of the story, and the common thread is a piracy comment from Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick. GTA 6 piracy is a real topic for any big release, but no reporting we can verify shows a working method on PlayStation 5.
The game is scheduled for November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a standard price of $79.99. Rockstar Games is the developer and publisher, and it is a publishing label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Our earlier look at how GTA 6 leaks moved Take-Two’s market value shows how sensitive the stock is to anything touching this launch.
This analysis separates what Zelnick actually said from what the headlines added. It also covers why piracy talk spikes around a launch of this size, what the legal and technical responses he described would involve, and what readers should do about fake files in the meantime. Every claim below traces to the confirmed record. Where the record stops, we say so.

Three outlets framed the story in similar terms. The framing has two parts. First, that Grand Theft Auto VI could be pirated on PlayStation at launch. Second, that the company behind Rockstar is relaxed about it. Both parts read like news, and both are easy to repeat. Neither is confirmed.
The first part is a prediction dressed as a finding. A headline that says a game “could be” pirated is true of nearly every game ever released, which makes it nearly impossible to disprove. It tells readers nothing about whether a jailbreak exists, whether a dump of the game exists, or whether copies would run on retail PlayStation 5 hardware. The reporting we reviewed names no exploit, no method, no pirate server and no unauthorized copy. The fact sheet for this story lists each of those as unconfirmed.
The second part, the idea that Rockstar’s owner is not worried, is a paraphrase of a longer remark. Zelnick did not describe indifference. He described piracy as a continuing issue and said the company would respond with legal and technical work if it became a problem. That is a posture of readiness, which differs from a posture of calm. The gap between the two matters for anyone trying to judge how seriously Take-Two treats the risk.
Editorially, this is a familiar pattern in gaming coverage. A CEO answers a question in an interview, a single line gets lifted, and the line becomes a headline that implies a bigger event. The event here is a speculative one: a piracy scenario that has not happened. Treat the story as a statement of corporate posture, not as evidence of a security failure.
The reporting cites Zelnick discussing piracy in an interview or event account. Two statements are confirmed word for word. The first is short: “Piracy is a fact of life.” The second is longer and carries the real substance of his position.
“It’s not been a non-issue. And in the event that it turns into an issue, we address it the same way every other business does, which is with legal work, and then with technical work, and we’ll have to do both.”
Read slowly, the quote says four things. Piracy exists. It has not been a non-issue for the company. If it escalates, the company will respond. And the response will have two tracks, legal and technical, both running together. Nothing in it says GTA 6 will be pirated. Nothing in it says the company is untroubled. The wording is closer to a risk statement from a company that has dealt with the problem before.
Zelnick also argued that game file sizes, game complexity and the need to connect to Take-Two’s servers can make piracy less useful than piracy of films or music. That is a business argument about the value of a stolen copy. A pirated movie is a self-contained file that plays anywhere. A pirated online game may be a large, partial experience that depends on servers the pirate cannot control. We return to that argument in a later section.
This is not the first time Zelnick’s phrasing has drawn a crowd. We covered Zelnick’s earlier exchange about 15 franchises and 5M+ sales , and the pattern is similar. He answers directly, and the internet compresses the answer.

Sofia Lindström November 8, 2026 14 min read The loudest question hanging over Rockstar’s biggest release is no longer about the map or the trailers. It is about GTA 6 piracy. LevelUp reported that Grand Theft Auto VI could be pirated on PlayStation at launch, while the owner of Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., says it is not worried. The Times and Mashable India ran the same story, and the framing across all three is a possibility, not a proven break.
That distinction matters. Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and digital pre-loading on PS5 is scheduled to begin at midnight local time on November 10. If you want the practical side of that countdown, our guide to the November 10 preload on PS5 and Xbox covers the logistics. This analysis stays on the piracy question: what was said, what is confirmed, and what remains guesswork.
The short version is simple. Nobody has confirmed that GTA VI will be pirated on PlayStation 5 at launch. Nobody has confirmed that a PS5 jailbreak will enable it. And nobody outside Rockstar and Take-Two has confirmed what protection the game ships with. What exists is a CEO who treats piracy as a permanent feature of entertainment and a launch date that is now less than two weeks away.

The story traces back to comments from Strauss Zelnick, Chairman and CEO of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. He discussed piracy in an interview with The Wall Street Journal, and the remarks spread quickly because of timing. Zelnick spoke as the biggest release of the season neared, and piracy is a sensitive subject for any publisher about to sell a $79.99 title.
Gaming outlets then built headlines on top of his words. Notebookcheck’s write-up put the central line in its headline, quoting Zelnick that piracy is a fact of life. LevelUp went a step further and tied the comment to PlayStation specifically, which is where the “could be pirated at launch” framing comes from.
Here is the catch. The PlayStation angle is an inference by the press, not a statement from Take-Two. Zelnick spoke about piracy as a general business reality. He did not say GTA VI had leaked, he did not say a PS5 exploit exists, and he did not describe any protection measure. Readers who skim headlines can easily walk away believing a pirated build is already circulating. The reporting does not support that.
The core remark is short. Zelnick said, in the words quoted across coverage, “Piracy is a fact of life.” The line is blunt, and it frames everything that followed. A CEO who says this is not promising an unbreakable launch. He is telling investors and players that every successful entertainment product gets copied, and that a publisher’s job is to manage the damage.
He then added a second, more operational statement: “It’s not been a non-issue. And in the event that it turns into an issue, we address it the same way every other business does, which is with legal work, and then with technical work, and we’ll have to do both.” Read closely, that sentence does three things. It admits piracy has been a real problem before. It says Take-Two will respond only if the problem grows. And it names two tools, lawyers and engineers, without naming a single product or technique.
The verified quotes pulled for this story, as reported by Mezha , place the remarks at the Wall Street Journal’s WSJ Tech: California event. Zelnick, according to that coverage, also compared games with other media. In his words: “I’ve been in every entertainment business there is, and when I was in the movie business, we figured 10-20% at any given time.”
He continued with the music business, where he said he worked from 1994 to 2000. Zelnick said: “In the record business, because I was in the record business from 1994 to 2000, by the mid 2000s, I would argue that 80% of that market was pirated; now that’s way back down again.” Taken together, the comments sketch his worldview. Piracy rises, an industry adapts, and the numbers fall again.

Polymarket has GTA VI at 97 or higher on Metacritic at 64% (-178), 96 or higher at 80% (-400) and 98 or higher at 35% (+186). The 94+ line is 97%. The market has traded about $70,000, so a few large orders can move it.
The bar is Rockstar's own record. GTA IV scored 98, and GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 both scored 97, per Screen Rant. Review codes reportedly went out at the end of October, and the review embargo is Nov. 18, one day before launch, per Beebom, citing NateTheHate and Insider Gaming. Rockstar has not announced that date. It matches the studio's last two launches. GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 reviews also ran the day before release, per GTA6-Life.
The pick: Yes on 97+ at 64% (-178). GTA IV, GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 all scored 97 or higher, and a studio that delayed this game twice and still sent out code three weeks early is not worried about reviews. The case against is the size of the sample: a game this big gets hundreds of reviews, and a few 8s would pull the average down. The 98+ line at 35% needs a new Rockstar record and is fairly priced. If you want to bet on the high end, 97 is the line.

articles.t: GTA 6 : un DLC officiel gratuit révélé par une fuite pour le plus grand plaisir des joueurs
articles.chapeau: À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6, une fuite Discord évoque une campagne Hexagon avec GTA 6 DLC gratuit et récompense mystère. Contenu, dates, enjeux : ce bonus soulève déjà bien des questions.
articles.txt:
À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6, une fuite Discord évoque une campagne Hexagon avec GTA 6 DLC gratuit et récompense mystère. Contenu, dates, enjeux : ce bonus soulève déjà bien des questions.
GTA 6 n’est même pas encore sorti et un premier « DLC » gratuit fait déjà parler de lui. Une fuite du code de Discord mentionne une campagne marketing baptisée « Hexagon » , centrée sur Grand Theft Auto VI , avec thème dédié et récompense mystérieuse à la clé.
Derrière ce nom de code se cacherait ce que certains médias décrivent déjà comme un premier GTA 6 DLC gratuit . Entre contenu cosmétique, éventuelle récompense in‑game et bonus de pré‑lancement, la communauté s’interroge sur ce que cette collaboration pourrait réellement offrir.
Le dataminer Wumpus Central a fouillé une version de test de Discord et repéré une campagne GTA 6 Discord nommée « Hexagon ». Dans les fichiers figurent une icône d’application GTA 6 , un app theme aux couleurs de Vice City et une police de pseudo inspirée de la typo officielle du jeu. Des sites comme RockstarINTEL ou GTA BOOM ont rapidement relayé l’information.
Plus intéressant pour les joueurs, le code mentionne une « quest with unknown reward » qui « may be coming soon during the campaign too », selon Wumpus Central sur X. GamingBible parle déjà de « first free in‑game reward » pour GTA 6 , d’où l’expression de contenu additionnel GTA 6 ou de « DLC gratuit ». Mais rien ne prouve encore que la récompense sera utilisable dans le jeu plutôt que limitée à Discord.
Les Discord Quest sont des campagnes où l’utilisateur doit accomplir une action pour décrocher une récompense : jouer à un jeu un certain temps, regarder un trailer ou participer à un événement. En 2022, par exemple, des quêtes liées à Fortnite Paradise permettaient de débloquer des objets in‑game, tandis que d’autres campagnes n’offraient que des cosmétiques Discord comme des décorations d’avatar.
Pour cette quête Discord GTA 6 , plusieurs scénarios sont plausibles : simple bonus Discord (thème exclusif, décorations de profil), skin d’arme ou tenue unique dans GTA 6 , voire petit avantage de pré‑commande lié au compte Rockstar Social Club. Dans tous les cas, il faudra très probablement accepter la Quest dans l’interface officielle, puis remplir l’objectif indiqué. Attention aux faux liens « GTA 6 Discord Hexagon » envoyés en message privé, terrain idéal pour le phishing .
D’après le datamine relayé par RockstarINTEL , la campagne Hexagon débuterait le 17 novembre 2026 à 18 h 00 UTC, soit 19 h en France, deux jours avant la sortie officielle de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Les utilisateurs gratuits pourraient participer jusqu’au 8 décembre 2026, tandis que les abonnés Discord Nitro auraient jusqu’au 15 février 2027.
Ce possible bonus GTA 6 avant la sortie s’inscrirait dans une stratégie où Rockstar Games mise sur des collaborations et des freebies plutôt que sur des DLC solo payants dès le lancement. Officiellement, ni Rockstar ni Discord n’ont confirmé la campagne Hexagon, qui pourrait encore être modifiée ou annulée. Les joueurs en quête de GTA 6 DLC gratuit ont donc tout intérêt à surveiller les annonces officielles et l’onglet Quest de Discord à l’approche du 17 novembre.

articles.txt:
Sony détaille un peu plus la rétrocompatibilité sur sa PlayStation 5. Il sera possible de jouer à la grande majorité des jeux PlayStation 4 sur la PS5, mais tous ne seront pas compatibles.
La sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) approche à grands pas et la boîte du jeu est déjà dans la nature. Des photos permettent de la découvrir.
Les photos de la version physique de GTA 6 sont apparues sur Reddit . Un employé d’une boutique en Allemagne montre l’avant et l’arrière. Sans surprise, il y a une mise en avant de Jason et Lucia, les deux protagonistes du jeu de Rockstar Games. De plus, on notera que la boîte indique un poids de 230 Go, alors que Rockstar Games a déjà annoncé une taille de 212 Go. Il est possible que le studio ait mis une petite marge sur la boîte au cas où.
Pour rappel, la version physique de GTA 6 n’inclut pas le disque . En effet, la boîte comprend seulement un code de téléchargement qu’il faudra utiliser sur le PlayStation Store ou Xbox Store pour récupérer le jeu. L’intérêt de la version physique en France est surtout son prix, puisqu’on la trouve à 60 euros chez plusieurs revendeurs, contre 79,99 euros pour le prix normal. GTA 6 sera disponible le 19 novembre. Le téléchargement une semaine plus tôt permet aux joueurs de se préparer et d’avoir fini le téléchargement pour y jouer dès minuit le jour de sortie.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 reportedly has 55 achievements set up, a new leak claims. That would be more than Rockstar Games included in GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2, and the…
articles.txt:
GTA VI: An Extended Look — When and Where to Stream Rockstar’s New Trailer GTA 6 reportedly has 55 achievements set up, a new leak claims. That would be more than Rockstar Games included in GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2, and the gap grows wider if you look only at single-player content.
This comes with a large caveat: it’s leaked information. Rockstar Games hasn’t officially confirmed the 55-achievement figure, so it should be treated as unverified until the official trophy and achievement lists are published.
The source is Tex2, a member of a GTA fan forum who also uses the name TexFunz2. The GTA community on social media later spread the post.
Tex2 says 54 of the achievements currently carry values between 1 and 54. The last one is valued at 1,000.
Fans have focused on that unusual figure. One theory is that the 1,000-value entry is a reward for completing the full list, which would make it a Platinum Trophy on PS5 or a Mythic Achievement on Xbox Series X |S. It may also mean nothing at all, since the values could be placeholders Rockstar replaces before release.
Set against Rockstar’s earlier games, the number stands out. The base PS5 trophy list for GTA 5 has 51 trophies, yet just 33 of those relate to offline play. GTA Online objectives and the Platinum Trophy account for the others.
Red Dead Redemption 2 follows the same pattern. Of its 52 PlayStation trophies, 34 are tied to the single-player game, while Red Dead Online achievements and the Platinum Trophy fill out the rest.
Do the math with the leaked figures. Should the GTA 6 list cover only single-player content (a big assumption), its 54 regular achievements would be close to double the single-player trophy count of either older game.
That might mean more activities, collectibles, side missions and challenges to complete. Still, an achievement total alone doesn’t prove how much content the game will contain.
None of the achievements in the leak come with names or unlock requirements. There’s no indication of how difficult they’ll be or how long a full completion will take.
Completionists have a number to go on and plenty of guesswork. The timing is strange too: GTA 6 is now near its November 19, 2026, release date, and the years of “before GTA 6” memes are about to end. Leaks are still appearing online regardless, and this is one Jason couldn’t fix.
Until Rockstar releases the actual list, the details are 54 entries valued from 1 to 54, a single entry valued at 1,000, and a forum user’s claim that the setup is genuine.

articles.t: Même pas encore sorti, GTA 6 a déjà rapporté une somme folle à Rockstar Games
articles.chapeau: Les précommandes numériques de GTA 6 ont déjà généré plus de 751 millions de dollars. La PS5 domine largement les ventes, à quelques jours du préchargement et moins de deux semaines avant la sortie du jeu.
articles.txt:
Les précommandes numériques de GTA 6 ont déjà généré plus de 751 millions de dollars. La PS5 domine largement les ventes, à quelques jours du préchargement et moins de deux semaines avant la sortie du jeu.
GTA 6 cumule déjà 751 millions de dollars de précommandes numériques, selon les estimations de Sensor Tower, avant sa sortie le 19 novembre. © Nesguk / Shutterstock GTA 6 n'est pas encore sorti que ses précommandes ont généré 751 millions de dollars dans le monde, à en croire le relevé de Sensor Tower arrêté au 3 novembre et qui, depuis, a dû se rapprocher un peu plus du milliard symbolique. Cette estimation, que Rockstar n'a pas confirmée, oublie même les boîtes vendues en magasin et laisse déjà GTA V derrière en nombre de réservations. Il faudra tout de même un peu de place pour le monstre dans les consoles, avec un préchargement avancé de deux jours, jusqu'à 212 Go à libérer et une PS5 Pro toujours sans réponse sur les 60 images par seconde.
BenQ BenQ iScreenBar : la barre lumineuse qui s’accorde avec l’iMac Des lignes en harmonie avec celles de l’ordinateur d’Apple, une conception rigoureuse, des matériaux sélectionnés, rien n’a été laissé au hasard, tout comme le service qu’elle rend une fois allumée !
Remboursements déduits, Sensor Tower estime à 7,71 millions le nombre de copies numériques de GTA 6 déjà précommandées . Un chiffre tout bonnement colossal. Le 13 octobre, le compteur affichait 6,08 millions, pour 594 millions de dollars. En trois semaines, le total a donc gonflé de 157 millions de dollars, soit environ 7,5 millions chaque jour. Une preuve que la « hype », comme certains disent, ne retombent pas. Pour vous donner une échelle, GTA V avait réuni 7 millions de précommandes en 2013, selon le même cabinet, avant de générer plus de 800 millions de dollars le jour de sa sortie . GTA 6 a donc déjà dépassé le premier score et se rapproche du second.
La Xbox ne joue, elle, que les seconds rôles. La PS5 concentre 74 % des précommandes , soit 5,74 millions d'exemplaires et 559 millions de dollars, contre 1,97 million et 192 millions sur Xbox Series. L'équilibre n'a pas varié depuis la mi-octobre, et les éditions en boîte, de simples codes de téléchargement absents de ce décompte, on le redit, pourraient encore creuser l'écart.
Autre enseignement, les acheteurs ne regardent pas à la dépense. À la mi-août, Sensor Tower attribuait 89 % des précommandes à l'édition Ultime de GTA 6 , à 100 dollars, contre 11 % à la Standard, à 80 dollars. Le revenu moyen actuel, environ 97 dollars par copie, colle à cette répartition. Il s'agit toutefois d'un montant brut issu d'un modèle d'estimation, avant la commission des boutiques, et non d'une comptabilité de Rockstar.
Lucia et Jason, les héros de GTA 6, main dans la main. © Alexandre Boero / Clubic / Rockstar Games Avant la sortie de GTA 6, il va falloir faire de la place La prochaine grosse échéance pour les fans de Grand Theft Auto, c'est le 10 novembre, d'ailleurs deux jours plus tôt qu’annoncé en juin, vous allez comprendre. Mardi s'ouvrira en effet le préchargement numérique, qui permet d'installer le jeu à l’avance pour y jouer dès son déverrouillage, à minuit sur PS5 et à 1 heure du matin, heure française, sur Xbox Series. Les boîtes, attendues le 12, ne contiennent qu’un code et passeront par la même étape. Rockstar demande jusqu’à 212 Go d’espace libre selon la console, soit, en théorie, une petite demi-heure de téléchargement avec une connexion à 1 Gbit/s, et près de 20 heures sur une ligne ADSL à son maximum, avis aux impatients !
Sur PS5 Pro, la fluidité reste l'une des principales inconnues. Une page fugace du site français de PlayStation aurait mentionné le PSSR, qui affine l'image à partir d'une définition réduite, et un ray tracing avancé, mais aucun mode à 60 images par seconde. Ni Sony ni Rockstar n'ont confirmé ce témoignage apparu sur Reddit, depuis effacé. Il s'accorde toutefois avec les 30 images par seconde que le vidéaste Davy Jones dit tenir, depuis fin août, d'un codirecteur de Rockstar North.
Le jeu se débloquera le 19 novembre à minuit, heure locale, treize ans après GTA V et toujours sans version PC annoncée. L'impatience nourrit aussi, et hélas, des commerces moins avouables, puisque par exemple, Avast a déjà repéré plus de 200 domaines liés au jeu en 24 heures, dont une vingtaine jugés à risque. Avec un tel engouement, tous les malfrats ne seront pas qu'à Vice City.

Le compte à rebours s’accélère pour GTA 6. Rockstar Games a mis en ligne 38 nouveaux visuels à deux semaines de la sortie, prévue le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S.
Les images montrent notamment Lucia et Jason, les deux protagonistes du jeu, mais aussi plusieurs personnages non jouables, ainsi que des scènes situées à Vice City et dans l’État de Leonida.
Parmi cette galerie, une image plus discrète se démarque : on y voit un homme cacher son visage avec sa main. Sans action spectaculaire, ce cliché tranche avec les scènes plus chargées et met en avant un détail plus simple, presque intime.
Ces visuels misent aussi sur le réalisme, pour donner un aperçu du monde ouvert avant même la sortie du jeu. Rockstar continue ainsi de faire monter l’attente autour de l’un des lancements les plus attendus de l’année.

articles.t: GTA 6 : 55 trophées et un platine entièrement solo, selon une fuite
articles.chapeau: Deux dataminers ont compté les trophées et succès de GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox. Tous viseraient le solo, alors que le platine de GTA 5 passait par GTA Online.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 compterait 55 trophées sur PS5 et autant de succès sur Xbox Series, d'après deux dataminers, à onze jours de la sortie du 19 novembre . Rockstar n'a publié aucune liste officielle.
Le compte côté Xbox vient de TexFunz2, puis le dataminer PlayStation Game Size a retrouvé le même total sur PS5, platine compris. Cette concordance rend la fuite plus solide, en attendant la liste officielle de Sony et de Microsoft.
Selon les deux relevés, aucun de ces objectifs ne concerne le multijoueur. Le changement est net pour les chasseurs de platine, puisque celui de GTA 5 exigeait d'atteindre le rang 100 de GTA Online (le trophée Above the Law).
GTA 5 proposait 49 succès sur Xbox 360 et 50 trophées sur PS3 à sa sortie en 2013 ; Red Dead Redemption 2 en alignait 51 sur Xbox One et 52 sur PS4, platine inclus. Avec 55 objectifs, GTA 6 irait au-delà de ces deux totaux, alors que ces listes réservaient plusieurs trophées au multijoueur.
Les dataminers n'ont publié aucun intitulé, pour ne pas éventer l'intrigue. La répartition entre bronze, argent et or n'est pas connue, pas plus que le nombre de trophées cachés ou le total de Gamerscore côté Xbox. La difficulté du platine reste donc impossible à mesurer, tout comme la part des objectifs qui suivront simplement l'histoire de Jason et Lucia.
D'après Rockstar, le jeu se débloquera dans la nuit du 18 au 19 novembre, à minuit sur PS5 comme sur Xbox Series. Le pré-téléchargement ouvre dès le 10 novembre, à minuit sur PS5 et à 1 h du matin sur Xbox, comme le détaille notre point sur l'heure de sortie en France . Les plus pressés peuvent tenter l'astuce de la Nouvelle-Zélande , qui donne accès au jeu douze heures plus tôt et suppose sur PS5 un compte néo-zélandais. La version boîte, qui ne contient qu'un code de téléchargement, se réserve chez les grandes enseignes, dont nous comparons les prix de précommande .

Mais ce grand écran ne se limite pas aux jeux vidéo. articles.t: GTA 6 arrive chez Carrefour dès lundi, avec un bon d’achat de 10 € - Toutes les Box
articles.chapeau: Carrefour ouvre lundi sa 2e vague Black Friday autour de GTA 6 : bon d’achat de 10 € hors marketplace, code dans la boîte dès le 12 novembre, PEGI 18.
articles.txt:
Carrefour ouvre lundi 9 novembre 2026 la deuxième semaine de son Black Friday, présentée comme celle des « avant-premières », avec GTA 6 en tête d’affiche. Sur le hub Grand Theft Auto VI de l’enseigne , un bon d’achat de 10 € est promis pour une précommande sur carrefour.fr, hors vendeurs partenaires et marketplace. Le jeu sort le 19 novembre, classé PEGI 18, mais la boîte ne contiendra qu’un code, pour lancer le préchargement à partir du 12 novembre.
Après la première semaine du Black Friday Carrefour, déjà ouverte autour d’un Dyson à 229 € , l’enseigne enchaîne lundi 9 novembre. Quatre rendez-vous sont prévus, un chaque lundi : le 2, le 9, le 16 et le 23 novembre.
Dans son communiqué du 2 novembre, Carrefour décrit cette semaine comme celle des « avant-premières » : équipement de la maison, expresso broyeur Delonghi, smartphones Samsung, GTA VI et un pack console Nintendo. Le communiqué ne chiffre pas ce pack : nous ne le présentons pas comme une promotion. Les offres varient selon les magasins participants et les stocks, en magasin comme sur carrefour.fr.
Vice City, le décor de Grand Theft Auto VI, attendu le 19 novembre 2026. © Rockstar Games Chez Carrefour, une boîte sans disque La fiche de l’ édition standard PS5 est claire : « La boîte de ce produit ne contiendra qu’un code de téléchargement permettant de lancer le préchargement à partir du 12 novembre. Aucun disque ne sera inclus dans la boîte. » L’envoi est annoncé à partir de cette même date. Le jeu est classé PEGI 18, et une précommande donne droit au pack Vintage Vice City. Le code PlayStation n’est valable que sur un compte enregistré dans une liste de pays, dont la France.

articles.t: GTA 6 : une fuite révèle plus de trophées PS5 et de succès Xbox que GTA 5 dès le lancement
articles.chapeau: Une fuite crédible agite déjà les chasseurs de trophées autour de GTA 6, attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Avec 55 objectifs solo évoqués, plus que GTA 5 au lancement, la future chasse au platine pourrait bien surprendre les joueurs les plus acharnés.
articles.txt:
Une fuite crédible agite déjà les chasseurs de trophées autour de GTA 6, attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Avec 55 objectifs solo évoqués, plus que GTA 5 au lancement, la future chasse au platine pourrait bien surprendre les joueurs les plus acharnés.
Les chasseurs de trophées risquent d’avoir du pain sur la planche avec GTA 6 . Une fuite relayée par plusieurs dataminers crédibles évoque 55 trophées sur PS5 et 55 succès sur Xbox Series X|S , tous liés au solo, soit plus que GTA 5 au lancement.
Si Rockstar Games n’a encore rien officialisé, ces chiffres partagés notamment par Notebookcheck et Insider Gaming dessinent déjà un record pour un jeu du studio. Et avec une sortie annoncée au 19 novembre 2026 uniquement en solo, sans mode en ligne ni microtransactions au day one, la question brûle les lèvres des completionnistes : à quoi va ressembler la chasse au platine dans l’immense État de Leonida ?
Côté Xbox, le dataminer TexFunz2 a repéré via un listing préliminaire 55 succès pour GTA 6 , dont un succès isolé affiché à 1 000 Gamerscore. Sur PlayStation, le très suivi PlayStation Game Size a confirmé le même total de 55 trophées sur PS5. Selon Notebookcheck, toute la liste serait orientée solo.
Sur Xbox, un succès à 1 000 G serait interprété comme une sorte de « mythic achievement » : un méta-objectif qui résume l’accomplissement ultime du jeu, comparable à un trophée platine côté PS5. Insider Gaming va dans ce sens en parlant d’une récompense pensée pour les joueurs qui poussent l’expérience à 100 %.
Reste un point crucial : au 21 octobre 2026, TheGTA6Gaming rappelle qu’aucune liste officielle de trophées ou succès GTA 6 n’apparaissait encore sur les stores Sony ou Microsoft . On est donc face à une fuite très commentée, mais qui ne sera validée qu’au moment où les serveurs PSN et Xbox publieront la liste définitive.
Historiquement, Rockstar Games était plus léger au lancement. GTA 5 arrivait avec 49 succès sur Xbox 360 et 50 trophées sur PS3, rappelle Notebookcheck, avant de grimper jusqu’à 78 avec l’ajout de GTA Online . Beaucoup de ces objectifs imposaient le multijoueur, parfois sur des activités désertes quelques années plus tard.
Red Dead Redemption 2 faisait à peine mieux : 51 succès Xbox One et 52 trophées PS4 au lancement, là encore avec plusieurs objectifs purement online. Résultat, d’après GTA6CheatSheet, environ 27 % des joueurs terminent l’histoire, mais seulement 0,5 % atteignent les 100 % et à peine 0,1 % décrochent le platine.
Si la fuite se confirme, les 55 trophées PS5 et succès Xbox de GTA 6 seraient donc tous réalisables en solo, sans avoir à subir la population des serveurs ou organiser des sessions de boost. Pour les chasseurs de trophées français, c’est une excellente nouvelle en termes de contrôle, même si la difficulté brute restera élevée.
La carte de Leonida serait sensiblement plus grande que les précédents mondes ouverts du studio. Le co-directeur de production Rob Nelson a expliqué que « l’histoire principale et quelques quêtes additionnelles représentent environ 80 heures de jeu « . Autrement dit, viser le platine ou l’équivalent 1 000 G demandera un investissement massif, même sans contraintes multijoueur.
GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , avec un préchargement attendu dès le 10 novembre selon Insider Gaming. Comme pour les autres AAA, la liste officielle des trophées devrait apparaître quelques jours avant, moment où il faudra choisir entre tout lire (et risquer des spoilers scénaristiques ) ou se limiter au simple nombre d’objectifs.
Dernier point à garder en tête : comme GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2 , GTA 6 devrait accueillir plus tard un successeur de GTA Online , possiblement accompagné de nouveaux trophées. Les chasseurs de platine les plus pressés auront donc intérêt à viser les 55 objectifs solo dès le lancement, tant que la liste reste « propre » et qu’aucun contenu additionnel ne vient relever encore la barre.

articles.t: GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements Leak Shows 55 at Launch - Shane the Gamer
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 trophies and achievements reportedly total 55 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. One Xbox entry is worth 1,000 Gamerscore, hinting at a Mythic tier.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 reportedly launches with 55 PlayStation 5 trophies and 55 Xbox Series X|S achievements, a longer list than either GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2 had on release day. The game is out on 19 November, and pre-loading opens globally on 10 November.
The Xbox figure came from dataminer TexFunz2 , whose data lists 55 achievements configured for the game. Dataminer PlayStation Game Size then found the same total on the PlayStation side. Neither leak includes achievement names, and Rockstar Games hasn’t commented on the numbers.
GTA 6 currently has 55 achievements configured. Interestingly, 54 use values between 1 and 54, while another is assigned 1000. That 1000-point achievement could be for completing the entire set, or it may be a placeholder for an Xbox Mythic achievement. via @TexFunz2 https://t.co/GAFWRVRX4d
On paper, 55 is a modest step up. Here is how Rockstar’s last two open-world games launched:
But those older totals overstate how much solo content they asked for. Some of GTA 5’s launch achievements could only be earned in GTA Online, and a good share of Red Dead Redemption 2’s were tied to multiplayer. Reports describe all 55 GTA 6 entries as single-player objectives. Because the leaked list has no names, that point depends on the reporting rather than the data. If it holds, the campaign checklist a completionist has to clear grows by more than the headline gap suggests, on top of a main story and side quests that Rockstar co-studio lead Rob Nelson has put at around 80 hours.
GTA 5’s list also kept growing after launch. The PS4 and Xbox One re-release added one more entry, and later GTA Online content took the total to 78.
In both older games, PlayStation has one more trophy than Xbox has achievements. That extra trophy is the Platinum, which Xbox has no equivalent for. GTA 6 has the same total on both platforms, and the Xbox data has an unusual entry: 54 achievements use values between 1 and 54, while the 55th is set at 1,000.
That 1,000-point entry could be a reward for completing the whole set, or a placeholder for an Xbox Mythic achievement. Mythic is Microsoft’s newer tier for players who finish everything in a game, and so far it has only appeared in Microsoft’s own first-party games, such as Gears of War: E-Day. On PS5, the matching slot would be the Platinum trophy, which unlocks once every other trophy is earned. A Rockstar release with a Mythic achievement would be the first time the tier has appeared outside Microsoft’s own studios.
A full Xbox game normally launches with 1,000 Gamerscore in total, and the leaked 55th achievement would use up that whole amount by itself. And if the other 54 run from 1 to 54 with no repeats, they add up to another 1,485, which would make the list worth 2,485 Gamerscore.
Those totals are far beyond a standard points split, so the scoring is likely to change before the list goes public. The count of 55 is the more solid part of the leak, since two dataminers found the same total on two different platforms. If the final Xbox list does keep a 1,000-point entry, a Mythic achievement becomes the stronger explanation.
Rockstar hasn’t published the list or any achievement names, so the official PlayStation and Xbox listings will be the first confirmation of both the count and the scoring.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 Physical Box Leak Reveals 230GB Requirement | ThePCEnthusiast
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 PS5 physical box photos have surfaced ahead of launch, revealing a 230GB minimum, online features, PS5 Pro support, and more.
articles.txt:
Facebook X Pinterest Photos of an alleged Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 retail box show a 230GB minimum storage requirement and several supported features. With Grand Theft Auto VI less than two weeks away from release, photos of what appears to be its retail PS5 box have surfaced online. While the packaging looks much like a typical PlayStation game case, the back reveals several details, including a 230GB minimum storage requirement that’s higher than Rockstar’s recently announced figure.
The photographs were originally shared on yesterday by Reddit user u/IseeIceTea, who claimed to work at a German retailer. The images show the front and back of a sealed GTA 6 PS5 case, complete with German-language descriptions, gameplay screenshots, and feature labels.
The original Reddit post has since been deleted, but other users saved the photos and reposted them on Reddit and X.
One of the more interesting details appears on the back of the photographed box, which lists 230GB as the minimum storage requirement.
That’s 18GB higher than the figure Rockstar announced on November 3. According to the company’s official pre-load FAQ, GTA 6 requires up to 212GB of available storage for pre-loading, depending on the console.
However, the two figures don’t necessarily contradict each other. The 212GB figure refers to the pre-load requirement, while the 230GB printed on the alleged retail packaging specifies minimum storage space. Additional installation space or reserved capacity could explain the difference.

The back of the GTA 6 PS5 box also lists several features, including single-player support, online functions, in-game purchases, and DualSense vibration and adaptive trigger support.
There’s also a PS5 Pro Enhanced label, although that isn’t entirely new information. Sony’s official GTA VI PlayStation listing already confirms PS5 Pro enhancement.
The online functionality label has attracted particular attention, with some fans interpreting it as a reference to the next generation of GTA Online.
However, the wording doesn’t confirm whether GTA Online will be available at launch. Rockstar has officially described GTA VI as a single-player experience, and online functionality could cover other connected features.
The packaging also features three small screenshots showing Lucia, Jason, and an aircraft flying over the Leonida Keys. These provide another look at the game’s characters and environments ahead of release.

The GTA 6 game cases are arriving with retailers and here is what’s included: – Game Case – A slip of paper with one side the cover art and the other the game code. – A slip of paper with an Ultimate Edition Upgrade prompt. – A double sided poster of the box art and cover girl. pic.twitter.com/8U8OsaQ5aB
Despite arriving in a traditional PS5 game case, GTA 6’s physical edition won’t include a Blu-ray disc. Rockstar confirmed this in June . Instead, buyers receive a digital download code. Physical pre-orders also include the Vintage Vice City Pack, featuring additional vehicles, outfits, hairstyles, and an exclusive weapon pattern.
What remains uncertain is whether the standard retail box includes a printed map or poster. The original Reddit uploader couldn’t open the sealed case to verify its contents. Meanwhile, some retailers explicitly advertises GTA 6 with an included poster, but that doesn’t confirm whether every retail copy comes with one.
Rockstar has separately announced a free downloadable Leonida map and cover-art poster for November 19. A printed double-sided version will also be available through the Rockstar Store shortly after launch.
Although the apparent retail copies have surfaced early, that doesn’t mean players can start playing GTA 6 ahead of schedule.
Rockstar confirms that digital pre-loading begins on November 10, while physical code-in-box editions become available through retailers starting November 12.
Players can redeem their download codes as soon as they receive them, but PlayStation’s official support page confirms that the game remains locked until its scheduled release.
Grand Theft Auto VI launches on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

articles.t: Take-Two Sheds $2.83B on GTA 6 Leak [2026]
articles.chapeau: Take-Two lost about $2.83B in market value after a GTA 6 leak, 11 days before launch. What is confirmed, what is not, and what comes next.
articles.txt:
Marcus Chen November 8, 2026 13 min read Take-Two Interactive lost roughly $2.83 billion in market value in under two days after unauthorized Grand Theft Auto VI footage appeared online, according to Simply Wall St . The number measures a drop in market capitalization. It is not a cash payment, a revenue hole, or a realized loss, and no official company statement ties the whole decline to the GTA 6 leak .
The footage began circulating on August 18, 2026. Rockstar Games, the studio behind the series, had already lined up its own answer: an extended preview called Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, scheduled to premiere on Netflix on August 27 at 3 p.m. ET. That sequence, an uninvited leak followed by an official showcase, makes this one of the more unusual stress tests a publisher has faced ahead of a blockbuster launch.
The stakes are concrete now. The game is officially set for November 19, 2026, which puts launch day 11 days out from this report, and the preload countdown is already shaping what players do with their consoles. Below, we separate what outlets have confirmed from what remains claim, and we look at what the sell-off says about how markets price a single game.

Add Tech Insider once in the Google app and our stories appear in your news suggestions.
The headline figure comes from market-price math. Reports describe Take-Two shares sliding quickly once clips of Grand Theft Auto VI spread across social platforms and video sites. Gagadget, citing Insider Gaming, put the move at roughly $15 per share within 48 hours, with the stock falling from a high of $248.13 to around $236 to $238. The same report said Take-Two began August with a market capitalization near $45 billion.
Do the arithmetic and the scale becomes clear. Against a base of about $45 billion, a $2.83 billion drop is a decline of about 6.3%. That is a sharp two-day move for a large-cap publisher, but it is not a collapse. One research summary we reviewed also cited a market-cap slide from about $44.9 billion to slightly above $43 billion during the sell-off, which is consistent with the same order of magnitude.
Two caveats matter here. First, the figure is attributed to market-price and market-capitalization calculations, not to a Take-Two filing or a spokesperson. We found no on-record quote from a named Take-Two or Rockstar representative confirming it. Second, stock prices respond to many inputs at once, including broader tech-sector sentiment and positioning ahead of earnings. The leak is a plausible trigger. It is not a proven sole cause.
The sequence of events is short, which is part of why the story spread so fast. Footage surfaced on August 18. Within two days, outlets were already tallying the damage in dollars. Rockstar then moved its own marketing forward on a planned date, giving investors an official piece of content to weigh against the leaked material.
Rockstar has kept up a steady drip of official material in the run-up to launch. Our earlier look at the 39 launch screenshots Rockstar published shows how much the studio now controls the visual story, which is exactly why unsanctioned footage is such a headache for the company.
Headlines that say Take-Two lost $2.83 billion invite a misreading. Pixel Twelve frames the figure as a market-cap drop on paper and separates it from any claim about revenue or cash. That distinction is the single most important piece of context in this story.
Market capitalization is share price multiplied by shares outstanding. When the price falls, the arithmetic value of the company falls with it, but Take-Two did not write a check for $2.83 billion. No studio funds changed hands, no sales vanished, and no development budget was drained. If the shares recover, the paper loss shrinks or disappears. If they do not, the company still ships the same game on the same date.
For retail investors, that table is the whole lesson. A large dollar figure attached to a leak sounds like damage to the business. In practice, it is a snapshot of sentiment over a handful of trading sessions.

articles.t: GTA 6 : 55 succès auraient fuité, avec une récompense qui intrigue sur Xbox
articles.chapeau: Des données relayées avant la sortie de GTA 6 évoquent 55 succès. Une valeur inhabituelle ne confirme toutefois pas encore une récompense Mythic.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 compterait 55 succès configurés avant sa sortie. L’information, relayée ce 8 novembre par Insider Gaming, provient de données partagées sur les réseaux sociaux. Un détail attire particulièrement l’attention : une entrée associée à la valeur 1 000. Elle nourrit l’hypothèse d’une récompense finale sur Xbox, mais ne permet pas encore de la confirmer.
Insider Gaming s’appuie sur une publication d’iGrandTheftAuto du 7 novembre, attribuée à TexFunz2. Selon celle-ci, 54 entrées utilisent des valeurs allant de 1 à 54, tandis qu’une autre porte la valeur 1 000. Cette présentation ne donne ni les intitulés complets des défis ni toutes leurs conditions.
Il faut donc distinguer le nombre annoncé de ce qu’il permet de conclure. Une valeur inhabituelle peut signaler une récompense particulière, mais aussi un emplacement provisoire dans les données. Elle ne suffit pas à annoncer 1 000 points de Gamerscore à gagner d’un seul coup, ni à certifier un trophée Platine identique sur PlayStation.
Les informations disponibles ne permettent pas davantage de calculer le nombre d’heures nécessaire pour tout terminer. Cinquante-cinq objectifs peuvent recouvrir des tâches très différentes : leur difficulté dépend des conditions exigées, pas de leur quantité.
La piste n’est pas sortie de nulle part. Microsoft a présenté les Mythic Achievements aux membres Xbox Insider le 29 septembre. Leur principe consiste à reconnaître l’obtention de tous les succès d’origine d’un jeu. Les objectifs ajoutés ensuite par un DLC ou une mise à jour n’entrent pas dans ce calcul.
Microsoft décrit aussi une barre de progression et un repérage des succès additionnels, pour savoir ce qui reste à obtenir. Ce dispositif distingue donc la récompense de complétion du simple total de points accumulés. Son existence ne valide toutefois pas, à elle seule, l’interprétation des données de GTA 6.
PlayStation rappelle dans son guide des trophées que le nombre d’objectifs, leur rang et les conditions d’obtention varient selon le jeu. Le niveau de rareté dépend, lui, de la proportion de joueurs qui les ont décrochés. « Rare » ne signifie donc pas automatiquement « long », et beaucoup de trophées ne garantissent pas une aventure plus vaste.
Une fois la liste accessible sur la console, le chemin passe par l’image de profil, puis Trophées et le jeu concerné. La PS5 permet également d’épingler jusqu’à cinq trophées pour garder leurs objectifs à portée de main. C’est plus utile pour organiser sa partie qu’une estimation de difficulté fondée uniquement sur cette fuite.
Pour l’instant, il manque surtout les réponses qui intéressent les chasseurs de récompenses : faut-il effectuer des défis dans un ordre précis, certains peuvent-ils être manqués, et quelles activités sont réellement requises ? Les données relayées ne tranchent pas ces questions.
Le rendez-vous confirmé reste le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Rockstar annonce le préchargement à partir du 10 novembre. La fuite des 55 succès constitue un indice à suivre ; elle ne remplace pas les conditions finales affichées par le jeu et les plateformes.
Pour préparer la place nécessaire sur votre console, le premier boîtier repéré avec une indication de stockage soulève une autre question, distincte de celle des succès.
Maxime Lefèvre suit l’actualité du gaming, des consoles et des nouvelles technologies. Il couvre notamment les univers PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo et PC Gaming, ainsi que les grandes annonces qui façonnent l’industrie du jeu vidéo.

articles.t: Une fuite de GTA 6 révèle plus de trophées PS5 et de succès Xbox dès sa sortie que pour GTA 5
articles.chapeau: La prochaine épopée criminelle de Rockstar pourrait devenir la nouvelle obsession des joueurs assidus. Une nouvelle fuite répertorie 55 trophées et succès Xbox à décrocher dans le mode solo de GTA 6. Les joueurs sur PS5 pourraient obtenir un trophée de platine, tandis que les fidèles des Series X et S viseraient un rare succès mythique.
articles.txt:
Rockstar semble prêt à mettre au défi les meilleurs chasseurs de trophées PlayStation et de succès Xbox . Deux fuites sur GTA 6 indiquent que le jeu proposera 55 objectifs à son lancement sur les deux plateformes. Comme ils concernent tous le mode solo, c’est plus que ce que les joueurs avaient eu à la sortie de GTA 5 .
Ces informations ne donnent aucun nom afin d’éviter d’éventuels spoilers sur l’histoire . Dans des informations relayées par GameRoll , TexFunz2 a d’abord révélé que les propriétaires de Series X et S auront 55 objectifs au lancement. Cependant, l’un d’eux vaut 1000 points, ce qui laisse penser que Microsoft pourrait introduire un succès mythique. Présent uniquement dans des jeux développés par les studios de Microsoft, comme Gears of War: E-Day , ce type de succès rivalise avec un trophée de platine PS5 et s’adresse aux adeptes du 100 %.
Le dataminer PlayStation Game Size a ensuite confirmé le même total pour la console de Sony. Par rapport aux précédents titres de Rockstar, cela pourrait nécessiter un nombre d’heures colossal. GTA 5 proposait à sa sortie 49 succès sur Xbox 360 et 50 sur PS3 , avant d’en ajouter 1 sur la génération suivante. Cependant, certains de ces exploits n’étaient réalisables que dans GTA Online .
La fuite concernant GTA 6 laisse également entendre que la tâche sera plus ardue pour les fans qu’à la sortie de Red Dead Redemption 2 . Au lancement, le jeu comptait 51 succès sur Xbox One et 52 trophées PlayStation sur PS4 , dont un platine. Là encore, beaucoup d’entre eux étaient axés sur le multijoueur.
La carte de Leonida est nettement plus grande que les précédents mondes ouverts de Rockstar . Il n’est donc pas surprenant qu’une exploration plus vaste s’accompagne de davantage d’objectifs en solo. Rob Nelson, codirecteur du studio, a indiqué que l’histoire principale et quelques quêtes supplémentaires nécessitent environ 80 heures de jeu. Compte tenu de la liberté dont disposent Jason et Lucia , décrocher un trophée platine ou un succès mythique dans GTA 6 pourrait s’avérer intimidant.
Même si elle pourrait n’arriver que bien après la date de sortie, une suite de GTA Online semble inévitable. Comme pour GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2 , elle apportera sans aucun doute de nouveaux trophées à GTA 6 .

articles.t: Les précommandes de GTA 6 en version physique pourraient inclure un poster plutôt qu’une carte, selon une fuite chez un revendeur
articles.chapeau: Les éditions physiques de GTA 6 ne proposeront pas de disque ni, vraisemblablement, la traditionnelle carte de Rockstar. Malgré tout, un magasin allemand prévoit d’inclure une affiche recto verso avec les précommandes avant la date de sortie. Cette aide à la navigation pliée pourrait être un bonus propre au magasin ou se trouver dans les boîtiers.
articles.txt:
L’annonce de Rockstar selon laquelle une carte de GTA 6 serait disponible sur son site web a suscité la déception. Les précédents titres incluaient ce supplément dans les boîtiers physiques . Cependant, un revendeur allemand a peut-être révélé que les boîtes contiennent un poster recto verso en bonus.
MediaMarkt a partagé des photos du poster recto verso sur son compte Instagram . L’illustration de couverture des versions PS5 et Xbox de GTA 6 figure sur une face, tandis qu’un personnage familier mais non nommé apparaît au verso. On peut également y lire « Bienvenue à Vice City », bien qu’aucune carte de la métropole ou de Leonida n’y figure.
Tout client qui achète le titre de Rockstar dans l’enseigne ou chez Saturn recevra le poster. Malheureusement, on ne sait pas s’il est inclus dans les boîtiers ou distribué séparément. L’entreprise n’a pas encore confirmé avoir dévoilé prématurément le contenu de la boîte. Toutefois, le fait que le poster soit aux bonnes dimensions et plié laisse espérer qu’il s’agit d’un bonus inclus dans tous les exemplaires.
La carte officielle de GTA 6 devrait être dévoilée à sa date de sortie ou peu après. Toutefois, les fans devront soit télécharger une version numérique , soit payer 99 cents, soit choisir des produits dérivés qui l’incluent en cadeau. Une carte imprimée similaire fait partie de la coûteuse The Goodtime State-Vice City Collection , toujours disponible en précommande.
Ces options ont suscité des grognements chez les partisans du disque , déjà mécontents de la solution du code de téléchargement en boîte . Un poster donnerait aux collectionneurs une raison de plus de ne pas se contenter d’un achat sur le Xbox Store ou le PlayStation Store .
Même si le bonus de MediaMarkt est proposé dans le monde entier, il ne satisfera pas les passionnés de géographie. Depuis Grand Theft Auto en 1997, des cartes accompagnaient la plupart des jeux physiques de Rockstar. Red Dead Redemption et sa suite ont perpétué cette tradition.
La date de sortie de GTA 6 approchant à grands pas, les joueurs devraient bientôt savoir si les boîtiers cachent une surprise. Ceux qui ont précommandé pourront récupérer leur exemplaire le 12 novembre. Des revendeurs comme Amazon devraient également commencer à expédier le titre à cette période.
